quotes.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with my experience. The biggest issue is the complete lack of transparency. There is no clear communication about what documents or information are actually required, how decisions are made, or what applicants are expected to do next. Every visit feels like a guessing game.

I’m not sure if this attitude is limited to this passport office or reflects a broader problem in government offices, but the level of arrogance and lack of empathy towards applicants is unacceptable. People come here because they need an essential government service, not because they have another option. Treating applicants as though their time has no value is simply disrespectful.

I’ve already wasted three full working days coming here, only to leave without any resolution, without clear guidance, and without even knowing when I should return or how to move my application forward.

The standard response is always, “Raise a grievance” or “Call the office.” But what’s the point when no one answers the phone, responds to emails, or provides any meaningful update? A process that depends on communication is completely broken when the communication channels don’t work. It feels like no one knows what needs to be done, and no one takes responsibility. That is incredibly frustrating.

The saddest part is that writing this review probably won’t change anything because applicants don’t really have a choice. We can’t simply decide to take our business elsewhere. If I had the option, after the frustration, wasted time, and complete lack of accountability I’ve experienced, I would gladly cancel my application and never come back. Unfortunately, I need a passport, and this office knows people have no alternative.

People deserve transparency, accountability, and basic respect. Right now, this process offers none of those.

The service provided is severely lacking, with inadequate responses for individuals in need of passport assistance. Communication via phone and email is ineffective, and the staff at the facility near the gate appear unprofessional, exhibiting disorganization and a lack of proper conduct. Furthermore, there have been instances of staff soliciting bribes to expedite processes, which creates a troubling environment for users. Recently, I encountered a situation where an officer requested 8,000 rupees to facilitate my verification at the RPO. It is imperative that stringent measures are taken to address these issues, as the staff demonstrates a lack of respect and professionalism. Additionally, the flag representing Karnataka has not been properly maintained, further reflecting poorly on their commitment to service. I am extremely disappointed by this experience.Please take proper action regarding this and hire well educated staffs and cops..

Part 2 : During lunch hours (1:30 PM to 2:15 PM), applicants were not even allowed to sit inside the building and were asked to leave and return later, which was highly inconvenient, especially for families with infants.

Post lunch, the situation worsened significantly. Tokens were reshuffled again, and people were called randomly into Ms. [name]’s cabin. This created chaos among the already frustrated crowd. Even applicants with early token numbers were pushed to the end—one person with token number 9 was called almost last, which felt completely unfair and unprofessional.

At the ground floor enquiry, a lady officer had clearly informed me that my issue would be resolved the same day. That was the only reason I waited there until evening. Otherwise, I would have left earlier and proceeded with reissue instead of wasting an entire day in such disorganized conditions.

Inside the cabin, it was evident that the officer was overwhelmed. However, the behavior displayed by Ms. [name] was highly unprofessional. There was constant shouting at applicants regardless of whether the mistake was theirs or not. There was no respect shown, even towards elderly people. Many applicants seemed to be facing similar issues, yet instead of providing guidance, the response was aggressive and dismissive.

When my turn finally came, I was told that the photograph cannot be changed and that I would have to apply for a completely new passport. This directly contradicts the information provided by multiple customer care agents earlier. I even spoke to some staff members outside, who suggested that reprinting the passport could be an option, but this was not acknowledged or considered.

As a result, I was forced to book another appointment, travel again to Bangalore with my 6-month-old baby, spend another full day, and go through the entire passport process once again, including police verification. I also had to pay for a new passport for a mistake that was clearly not from my end.

This entire experience has caused unnecessary financial burden, time wastage, and significant stress. It was extremely frustrating to deal with such unorganized systems, lack of coordination, and unprofessional behavior from staff and constables.

For a central government office like this, which is expected to maintain efficiency and accountability, this experience was shocking. Public reviews online seem to reflect similar issues, and unfortunately, I had to go through the same.

Strict action should be taken against such behavior. Officers handling public should maintain basic professionalism, patience, and accountability. If they are unable to manage public interaction or maintain their temperament, they should not be assigned to such roles.

Overall, extremely poor management, no transparency in process, lack of accountability, and complete disregard for people’s time and effort. A very disappointing experience.

I have applied for Passport through Normal mode in POPSK jalahalli on 4th June without knowing the complication that going through POPSK would take time. Mine status on the passport seva app was showing " application received with necessary documents" till 16th June. I was boathered why the police verifiation process was still not  initiated since within 8 days (and some cases on the day or next day it should be initiated)  it should have been done. I decided to go to the RPO, kormangala office for a walk in enquiry. Even though getting in to the counter/ window where we can raise our enquiry is hectic ( big ques for getting tocken, prefernces for Online registed / elderly people/agents people etc), the person on the enquiry counter was so polite and addresses to the issue in a effective manner. He asked me to write a letter regarding my issue and he would forward it to the concerned officials in the office and told me that within a week they would initiate  the police verification. Kuddos to that person I got a message 19th june to go to the police station for verification.
If you have facing similar type of issue or any other type where in the status isnt changing for weeks, better to approach RTO office bangalore directly.

I am writing to bring to your kind attention the delay in the processing of my 17-year-old son’s passport renewal application.

Due to unavailability of appointments in Bangalore, we traveled to KGF on March 26th and successfully completed the application process there. The next day, we received a notification for police verification, which we promptly completed at our nearby station. The verification report was forwarded to the Koramangala Regional Passport Seva Kendra soon after.

Since then, we have been regularly checking the status online and contacting the call center. The portal continues to show that "police verification has not been cleared". However, upon speaking with the call center representatives, we were informed that the police verification has indeed been approved at the local station and that the application is currently pending at the Koramangala Passport Office.

We have made repeated attempts over the last two weeks to contact the office by phone and online, but unfortunately without any success. Additionally, the passport portal has recently been experiencing technical issues, making it impossible to get updated information or book an appointment.

We are now in a difficult position as we have international travel planned for April 15th, and we are extremely concerned about the delay.

My passport renewal was stuck for more than a month. inspite of completing the verification successfully, The status was “police verification review pending at RPO” . I went to RPO Bengaluru for passport surrender. It appears recently the RPO has transitioned to a 2-day visit. On first visit, original documents would be verified, photocopies would be submitted for approval.

On second visit (after 10-14 days), after approval biometrics/photo would be taken and given the surrender certificate with cancelled passport. You still need to carry all original documents. No one called me, so I did walk in after 10 days. Many other people did the same.

I was initially told by PSK helpline that surrender can be done at any RPO which was incorrect. You should have an address proof to indicate that RPO can serve your location.

It was a bit chaotic at the RPO but officers were helpful and courteous. Process is very simple but you have to be patient. Be sure to carry all documents along with photocopy. There are plenty of shops nearby for getting photo/print outs.

quotes.text: Do not go for any Agent! Just login to psk website and you can apply for passport yourself. Tip to apply. Make sure any simple change or any details you add to ur passport you need to submit supporting document. For ex: if u renew or re-apply for passport and change status from single to married. You need to give ur marriage certificate which they won’t ask while you apply for it.

I honestly expected the worst after reading many of the reviews here. I was pleasantly surprised at how great the service was. Now I can't comment on individual experience because that differs person to person. However, I would like to help out new applicants with a streamlined process on how to get things done efficiently.

1. Make sure to have plenty of patience before you reach, 90% of the application process is the waiting game. Also try to choose a weekday slot, lesser crowd.
2. Digilocker is your best friend. Ensure your documents are uploaded to the passport site before your scheduled date. This is  key to a smooth process.
3. Once you reach, you'll be greeted to a crowd, ensure you pay attention to your "REPORTED TIME" which is usually 15 minutes behind your "Appointment time".  A guard comes and calls people in-between slots. Take your seat outside until then, there are chairs.
4. Your appointment time is sacred. An applicant was rejected for being late by an hour. Ensure you reach early and take a seat until your "Reported time" is called out. Once called, stand in the line and you'll be let in. Carry a Xerox of your Online Application Receipt. This one has your ARN number on it.
5. Once inside, head towards the token counter, usually, counter no 5 or 6 is the designated area for Digilocker but even if you are given a normal number, don't worry, once you go to Counter A, your uploaded Digilocker documents will automatically be detected by the system. Regardless of having a N or S in your token number. There is a manual entry procedure after you stand in the queue, where you enter your ARN and Date of Birth. You go back to the token counter and they'll give you a token number.
6. Make sure to take a seat near the display screen and you'll go through 3 counters (A, B and C). Counter A takes your biometrics (fingerprints) and photo. So, you do not have to bring passport photos, a fresh photo will be taken on site. Counter A is also the place where you can correct all your entered details so don't worry if you've made a mistake on your passport application while applying. Address and document proofs can be changed too. Counter A takes roughly 10 minutes of waiting time as they have 30+ designated areas.
7. Now the waiting game begins. The same token number will be used for Counter B and C. After you are done with A you will come to a new waiting area inside. Both B and C are displayed on a single screen so pay attention. It may take you 15 minutes or upto an hour depending on the crowd for each of this. It varies.
8. You could be asked to go from C to A if something doesn't match and you start the process again. Remember to be very patient and alert. Afterall, it's a passport process, the gold standard of identity verification.
9. Ensure you bring the long Aadhar card with the QR barcode and not the business card sized Aadhar. I saw people being rejected or told to get a printout of their Aadhar. Ensure all your documents are original and uploaded on the site, this is the big difference between a longer and a shorter wait time. Your original documents will be verified twice in B and C.
10. Once you are done verifying at counter C (Congratulations!) you won't receive any physical acknowledgement receipt, it will automatically update on the passport site (login to see the progress). You will receive SMS alerts of your passport progress. You can head for the exit.

While different people may have different experiences, I can't vouch that one agent's behavior would be better than the next. I can vouch for being polite even if they are rude, because ultimately, getting tensed or stressed never solves issues and it only aggravates the entire process.

Once your application is done. A nearby police station is assigned to you, you can check which one through the passport login. And expect a visit/call from them.

All the best. It took me 2-3 hours for everything and much of it is simply waiting inside the center. The offices are air conditioned so the waiting time went by quickly since I had music for company. Goodluck.

Passport Kendra Review

The place was too crowded, no need to go early to secure first place. The security person will allow you as per reporting time only, 15 minutes before reporting time is sufficient.

Important: Once you enter you are not allowed to go out. Better to carry your choice of food as the counter serves limited food items and very expensive - sandwich, puff, 2 varieties of juice, samosa and 1 cake item.

Initially, when you go inside you will get token only if all documents are clear. Post that you will have to wait till your turn comes, counter A, B and finally C.

We can see the token order in tv screens which they have displayed at the waiting area.

Counter A : In this counter itself they would take photo, signature, spellings, address confirmation. Be very vigilant here, once entered it cannot be corrected until you take a fresh appointment and follow all the process. This counter is managed by TCS and they are very quick.

Counter B : To get into this B part itself will take 1 and half hour time, too long to wait. If it is lunch hour, then expect 30mins more delay.

Here they will check all original documents that you had submitted passport on the website or thru agent while getting an appointment.

Counter C: Even this counter would take 1 hour waiting time. For us, this got more delayed because there are only 11 counters but 5 were operational.

This is the final process for approval of passport & final verification of documents, then Exit.

If the system goes down or due to unforeseen situation you might spend an entire day here.

Best case: 3 hrs
Worst case: entire day

Other reasons for delay:

1. Senior citizens are given first priority
2. Medical reasons could get high priority
3. If you go as a family, parents and 2 kids for passport renewal or new passport then you can start the children process only when you get the BN number. So, by then there could be 200 members who would have gone ahead of you. Even though you finish the process, you will still have to wait until your children turns come.

Improvement needed:
1. Streamline process if you go as a family, so that everybody can finish at once and not wait until the other has reached first stage
2. Seats are very less and people end up standing for hours, including senior citizens
3. At least have 2 South Indian simple meal (noon) apart from snack items
4. Photocopy price to be reduced
5. Additional washroom facility for a crowd of 500 people, not just 1

The previous time completed the process in 30 minutes (as senior citizen) & was expecting the same today.
Was very disappointed.
The process took 1 hour 40 minutes via the senior citizen routing.
Firstly at the online application stage fresh versus reissue not clear.  Suggest use ' Renewal ' other suitable word.
At step 1, getting a token number ( at senior citizen/ infant / Differently abled persons counter - All age group people were there. Two queues were at the same counter, as after first review of application & documents, entry of application no. was needed. So after review, one had to go & get application no. entered in system by a person & return to token counter.
I spent about 1 hour in this queue though they were only 7 people ahead of me. Delay is due to people getting application no. entry & returning to same counter but in a pararell queue.
Also security guard outside had no instructions to allow senior citizens via separate queue to enter the entry waiting room.
From after getting the token no. the process was better with guidance via the tv screen & directed through the 3 step process.
The token counter needs a rethink of the process & counter assistant to be given detailed process to be followed.
This will streamline the process. Also will ensure a cycle time if about 30 minutes for senior citizens.
Regards.

The queuing system at this facility is poorly organized 👎, causing considerable delays. The limited food options provided are also unsatisfactory 🍔. These deficiencies significantly diminish the overall experience, often requiring a full day for completion 👎. My visit was inefficient and disappointing 😔.

Severe overcrowding: Around 100 people were packed into the first verification area, with only fans and poor ventilation. The situation was suffocating, especially for seniors and children.

Document advisory mismatch: The online document advisory does not match the actual requirements. I was sent back three times for different photocopies/forms, each time waiting 30–40 minutes in the queue.

Unnecessary additional process: The newly introduced kiosk requires another manual entry, followed by yet another queue for the token, adding to the confusion and delays.

Excessive waiting: I spent nearly 2½ hours dealing with verification, documents and token queues before reaching the actual processing counters.

Poor seating: With the huge rush, there were hardly any vacant chairs. At Counter C, I had to stand for nearly 30 minutes as no chair was available, even though seating should be prioritised for seniors and persons with disabilities.
Unequal AC facilities: Air conditioning was excellent in the officials’ area but inadequate in the customer waiting areas.

Staff coordination: Staff guidance was inconsistent and lacked courtesy. Applicants should be given complete and accurate information at the first verification itself. They didn't give chair and staff told me if you find any empty one pull it!

Overall: The process is poorly coordinated and unnecessarily time-consuming. Tirupati Passport Seva Kendra is far better managed. The SOPs, document advisory and actual requirements need to be aligned urgently.

Pathetic. Useless token system with unprofessional guys sitting at the token desk to demean people. No clear instructions provided. Randomly asking for Tatkaal form which was not intimated before - form of a corrupt practice to force us to use the printing shop inside.

Spent 4 hours even to get infant’s process done with both parents having passports and by being on Tatkaal scheme.

Worst service and rude staffs.

We came here for passport renewal verification. Our slot was at 11:30am. We reached before 11am. They asked us to wait there. There was a long queue. They were calling for 10:30 slot batches at 11:40 only. We were allowed only at 1pm. And then they took 3hrs 30mins to process.
They simply said there is a server error for whole day.
The staffs working inside are so rude with applicants.

It's good! But always crowded! It took me 4 hours to complete the verification!

They haven't mentioned about manual verification step before going to different zones and getting a ticket!

No proper sign board where to start!

I took tatkal ! So go to dedicated place to check you have bought all documents and manual verification of aadhar card and ARN number then generate token !

And go to different zones!
excellent the flow of process is very good except for manual entry section where we have to go one step back
Good service

Went with our child (under 4) for a fresh passport and were pleasantly surprised. Minors are given priority like senior citizens, and the staff kindly allowed both of us parents in. The priority queue moved quickly through counters A, B and C, and we were in and out in about 30 minutes. Really thankful. Kudos to the staff at PSK Lalbagh for making it so smooth for families with little kids! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Firstly, the parking for four wheelers is very limited. You may end up parking on the road itself. The office is pretty close to the Nallurhalli metro station.

It's a new facility and there are a lot of teething issues. The security staff and staff at the token counter need to more clear with instructions. Once you enter the premises, please join the queue based on your appointment type to get your documents verified. Once verified, you are asked to register at the kiosk. Kindly use your ARN No to register and head back to the counter for getting your token assigned.

The A counters are plenty and expect things to complete pretty soon. The B & C counters took a bit longer as we opted for the normal passport type. The Sr [name] and Tatkal were prioritised more.

Requesting the team to have atleast one counter marked for the Normal passport applicants. In total, took around 2 Hours and 15 minutes.

quotes.text: I had an appointment of 1215pm and was finally allowed inside at 1600. There is no order and the whole process is a mess. They are super slow and not meant to handle the volume of applicants. No value for someone's time. Even after getting in, they started asking for additional documents and sending you over 4kms to get printouts and none of those documents ended up being needed. The application was stuck for over 3 weeks until i decided to get in touch with an agent who clearly mentioned that the files from this PSK are generally processed last and end up having extended waiting times. Its always better to just go to lal bagh instead

Documents needed.
1. PAN / Voter id
2. SSLC MARKS CARD
3. AADHAR CARD
+ Marriage certificate or couple photo with signature of both with there annexture.
DOB and Name should compulsorily match in all submitted documents, get xerox and not printout of same. Aadhar shouldn't have question mark.

Well after having a smooth expirence getting my Passport done at Lalbagh, sent my parents to Jalahalli PSK as it was better accessible to us and nearby, Both my parents application are in hold due to poor scan done by [name] agent and another for submitting aaadhar printout copy with question mark. The person checking the documents could have straight rejected the non qulifiable documents instead of making us wait and run behind other office appointments, I was angry about Lalbagh staff with their strictness with documents verification before but after facing issues with my parents documentation at Jalahalli PSK, I think it's good approach and they should train their PSK employees like the well trained one's at Lalbagh PSK. Better dispoint me in the beginning then making the process it's self a regrettable one.

WORST EXPERIENCE. DONT GO HERE. We submitted our application on 4th August. Police verification finished by 15th August. Checked the status on 18th August, said the application is being processed at the RPO, Bengaluru. Kept checking the status till 31st August, but STILL THE SAME. So what do I do, call up the passport grievance cell, but they say please visit the RPO. Too far, tried to contact the RPO on phone. NO RESPONSE! TRIED CALLING ALL THREE NUNBERS FOR A WHOLE FREAKING DAY, NO RESPONSE! Tried other means of communication from 20th August via email, tweet. BAM! NO RESPONSE! This is the pathetic state of affairs at the POPSKs . Go there ONLY IF YOU ARE READY TO WAIT FOR 2-3 MONTHS FOR YOUR PASSPORT (Turns out that you gotta pay the agents to get it done asap. That's the racket they are running,)Apparently, that is the waiting time because the so called Passport Officer doesn't process the applications received via other PSKs in the same pace as he does for other applications received via PSK Lalbagh even though you have paid the same amount. It's been a month now of NO responses from their side and they say "Acche Din" and we are just waiting for the passports to arrive even though all the formalities are completed. There is no zero star rating on Google, otherwise I would have given the same.
Always delay
Worst experience more than 3 month after process stilll didn't received the passport
I Applied my daughter renewal passport but still pending… y even police verification also done last year 7 feb I apply till now not received passport

The worst passport office in Bangalore.
Today is 29 October 2025. I have been waiting for my passport for the last 15 days. As per the scheduled appointment I had submitted all the documents on 14 October 2025 to the passport seva kendra of Jalahalli Bangalore, due to the incompetent, untrained, unprofessional staff of the seva kendra my passport file is kept pending by the Bangalore regional passport office, after a long wait I made a lot of enquiries regarding my file and got to know, because of the mistake of the incompetent genius staff who verified my documents put the verification seal on my 10th marksheet on the back of the sheet instead on the front sheet and did not scan it at all, my file is kept as pending by the Bangalore regional passport office. I don't know what sort of hideous training has been given to the staffs.The sad part here is I did not receive any intimation from the Bangalore regional passport office (Koramangala) regarding this issue and I have been blindly waiting for my passport for the past 15 days and when I enquire about this to the helpline centre the staff does not respond properly to my request in short they provide no help at all. When I reached out to the Jalahalli seva kendra with regards to their mistake they do not lift a finger to sort out this problem and later I was asked to get the verification seal on the front sheet of my 10th marksheet and speedpost the document  to the Bangalore regional passport office and I still haven't received any status update regarding my file moreover when I enquire about this to the help center I am asked to wait for a few more days apparently it will take a month more for me to get my passport all because of a stupid mistake of one untrained staff of the seva kendra, I had to take leaves from my work figure out what the problem is and take steps to solve it on my own when the problem was caused  by the so called central government staff who is unprofessional and not serious about their work.

Hiiiii whoever reading this, will be surely help you.....
If u need ur passport urgently means donot think of going here......visit to lalbaag.....
I'm waiting from june month to get my passport in my hand , doc verification police' verification all done......3 months almost completed from the day of application.....

When it comes to staff working there, i felt little rude, they should think, they are the only one to help people,
A gentle reply from staff would make people more happy, that's all they need to improve......I know they are stressed at their work but yes this is how the world is.....
My process was smoothly went
Carry sufficient documents even though you feel you dont need them, especially who are married take their marriage certificate, they ask for it for sure, i don't know why.......be on time 15min late is quite okay,as per my experience otherwise u will not be attended,
Thats all from my side.....
